ios.desc:
NextDNS protects your device from ads, trackers, malware, and other harmful domains while keeping your internet activity private.

All DNS traffic is encrypted, preventing networks and internet providers from seeing or manipulating your DNS queries.

Protection across your device

NextDNS works system-wide across apps and browsers.

• Block ads and trackers automatically
• Protect against malware, phishing, and malicious domains
• Enable parental controls and content filtering
• View analytics, query logs, graphs, and domain details in a native dashboard

Easy setup

Create your NextDNS profile in seconds or connect an existing one.

Your configuration is managed at my.nextdns.io, where you control blocking rules, security settings, and privacy features.

Control on iPhone and iPad

The app lets you manage protection on your device:

• Enable or disable NextDNS anytime
• Temporarily pause protection and resume from a live activity
• Optionally send your device name for easier identification in logs
• Quickly unblock domains from the app
• Exclude trusted Wi-Fi networks
• Exclude specific domains and their subdomains so they use the system DNS resolver

Privacy Policy: https://nextdns.io/privacy
